code_commit_note: All benchmark/training/analysis code is from commit 5b7b46f; commits after it on the branch only add result artifacts under results/. Result JSONs record the result-commit HEAD at their run time with a '-dirty' suffix because the results directory itself was being written during the runs; no source file differed from 5b7b46f during any run.

agents.name: PPO
agents.hyperparameters_note: All other hyperparameters are the shipped ml/train_ppo.py defaults: lr 3e-4 AdamW wd 1e-4, GAMMA 0.999, LAM 0.95, CLIP 0.2, ENTROPY 0.01, VALUE_COEF 0.5, PPO_EPOCHS 4, league snapshot every 8 iters (max 5), mixed_field opponents.

analysis.method: paired percentile bootstrap, 10000 resamples, bootstrap seed 0

notes: Model checkpoints (*.pt) are gitignored per repo convention and NOT stored in Git; only their SHA-256 fingerprints are recorded. Exact re-verification of these numbers requires the binaries (or retraining with the recorded commands, which is expected to reproduce them on the same software versions).

Determinism cross-check: the BC and BC+DAgger 1000-game benchmarks were each executed twice (once under heavy concurrent CPU load, once on an idle machine); both produced byte-identical placement sequences. The committed JSONs are the idle-machine runs.
Decision latency figures are from the idle-machine runs; contended runs had inflated latency (placements unaffected).
Training-time eval printouts in ml.bc / ml.train_ppo logs are legacy diagnostics (30/40 episodes, seed 9000), NOT official results. Only the 1000-game Benchmark v1 JSONs are canonical.
